astrometric_calibration.calibrated_tier_requirement: at least 30 tight references in that opportunity
astrometric_calibration.reference_definition: Same as frozen v094l: mutual-nearest SAME_GAIA pair, observed A/B separation <=5 arcsec, and both APPLAUSE-to-Gaia match distances <=1 arcsec.
astrometric_calibration.reference_fit: Recompute the frozen v094l robust affine clipping only to identify retained ordinary-star references; then map B into the A astrometric frame using the component-wise median B-A offset of the 25 nearest retained references to the B-source location (minimum 10).
astrometric_calibration.uncalibrated_tier: Opportunities lacking >=30 references are still searched with raw astrometry and labelled HOLD_UNCALIBRATED_ASTROMETRY; they cannot be called strong candidates in v094n.

blinding.blinded_result_ledger: May contain SHA256 candidate hashes and physical metrics, but no source IDs, Gaia IDs, coordinates, plate IDs, scan IDs, solution IDs, or opportunity IDs.
blinding.private_machine_map: A private work-state CSV may contain candidate hash -> source/opportunity identifiers and coordinates for later registered follow-up. It is hash-manifested but must not be inspected before the v094n aggregate stop.

epipolar_geometry.baseline: duration-weighted simultaneous ECI site-B minus site-A baseline across all positive fragment-overlap intervals
epipolar_geometry.candidate_generation: Exact spherical epipolar-plane interval join. Around each B-side source, derive the allowable epipolar azimuth interval corresponding to a raw cross-track tolerance of 7 arcsec, then range-join A-side epipolar azimuths. This is a generator only and does not define scientific acceptance.
epipolar_geometry.signed_disparity: With baseline axis from A to B, physical simultaneous parallax requires the B-side polar angle about that axis to exceed the A-side polar angle. The opposite sign is the anti-parallax null.
epipolar_geometry.why_7_arcsec: The previously frozen tight reference population has raw same-Gaia A/B separation <=5 arcsec; adding the fixed 2-arcsec final physical closure tolerance gives a conservative 7-arcsec generator that can accommodate the validated relative astrometric field without imposing a source-pair distance maximum.

fixed_physical_acceptance.horizon_check: report below-horizon/inconsistent solutions separately; do not promote them
fixed_physical_acceptance.maximum_distance: source-specific Dmax = projected simultaneous baseline perpendicular to the A-side line of sight / tan(2 arcsec)

input_population.common_footprint: exact selected-solution common footprint inherited from v094i-v094m
input_population.nonoverlap: 159 >0-5 minute opportunities remain HOLD_MOTION_PARALLAX_DEGENERATE and are not paired in v094n
input_population.source_pool: For each overlap opportunity, remove every Gaia identity present on both science sides of the common footprint. Every remaining strict-HQ incidence with its side-specific Gaia identity remains eligible; no angular separation maximum and no nearest-neighbour requirement is imposed.

known_at_freeze.interpretation_boundary: The physical search space is tractable enough to run a directed matcher, but chance burden is strongly heterogeneous. Therefore a signed geometric null and strict blinding are required before individual inspection.

null_model.definition: Use the same epipolar generator and the same absolute disparity, cross-track, source pools and opportunity geometry, but count pairs whose corrected B polar angle is smaller than A by >=2 arcsec. Compute a pseudo-range from the same stereo triangle using absolute signed disparity. This is a matched geometric chance/systematic null, not a physical object solution.
null_model.name: ANTI_PARALLAX_SIGN

purpose: Perform the first physically directed, no-angular-maximum source pairing on the corrected <=5-minute actual-overlap population. Use exact epipolar geometry from the simultaneous observatory baseline, preserve all strict-HQ sources whose Gaia identity is not shared across the two science sides, and compare the physical parallax sign against an anti-parallax sign null before any individual candidate inspection.
stop_rule: Stop after aggregate physical-vs-anti-parallax counts, distance/disparity/site/epoch/calibration strata and candidate concentration/reuse diagnostics. Do not inspect private candidate identities until that aggregate stop is interpreted.
